sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description:
If true, the function waits for the image to be generated and uploaded
            before returning, so the image is returned directly (base64) instead of
            via the CDN. Increases latency.

autocrop.title: Autocrop
autocrop.description: Tighten the output canvas to the kept content.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: Source image as a public URL, a base64 data URI (data:image/png;base64,...) or raw base64-encoded image bytes.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Optional. Plain words for how to change the default cutout of the photo's obvious subject: add something ('the person with the mat and the plant'), drop something ('the woman at her desk without the lamp') or narrow it ('only the chair'). Everything kept is the original pixels with a new alpha channel. Leave it empty for the plain cutout of the obvious subject.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
